title: RCP-C No. 1 Seal Leakoff Flow Above Administrative Action Level
description: During routine parameter surveillance at 100% power, U1 reactor coolant pump C seal leakoff flow (U1-FT-RCP-C-SEAL1) observed at 2.4 gpm, exceeding the administrative action level of 2.0 gpm. Plant stable; no automatic actuation. CR initiated per SOP-U1-RCP-004. Initial review shows no preceding alarms or SOE data available — process computer in scheduled backup window at time of initial deviation. TSKR patterns available from independent subsystem.
data_availability_note: Process computer historian in scheduled backup maintenance window at time of initial deviation. soe_log and alarm_log are NOT available for this event. TSKR patterns are available (independent subsystem with dedicated data retention).

immediate_response.operator_action: CR-2026-04-1182 initiated. RCP-C seal leakoff monitoring frequency increased per SOP-U1-RCP-004. Engineering notified. No plant transient. Power ascension/reduction not required at this leakoff level.
